current_season_games_prior.explicit_pre_hgb_interaction_or_transfor: none; numeric feature is standardized and passed to frozen HGB
current_season_games_prior.operational: count matching same-season strict-prior official player-game outcome rows
current_season_games_prior.training: count of strict-prior player-game outcomes in the target canonical season
current_season_games_prior.zero_behavior: 0 when no same-season prior rows; missing normalized to 0 at HGB scorer input

current_season_points_prior.explicit_pre_hgb_interaction_or_transfor: none; numeric feature is standardized and passed to frozen HGB
current_season_points_prior.operational: sum of official goals plus assists for prior player-game outcomes where game_date < target game_date and canonical_season equals target season
current_season_points_prior.training: sum of strict-prior realized points in the target canonical season
current_season_points_prior.zero_behavior: 0 when no same-season prior rows; missing normalized to 0 at HGB scorer input

cutoff: strict game_date < target game_date; same-date outcomes excluded
season_ppg_prior: diagnostic only: points_prior/games_prior when games_prior > 0; missing at zero games; never passed to HGB
